{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.","required_artifacts":["/app/solution.txt","local copy or downloaded media evidence for the referenced video"],"required_behaviors":["Acquire the referenced video from the provided URL or an equivalent visible source.","Extract the complete ordered move sequence from the video content.","Write the move sequence to /app/solution.txt with exactly one move per line."],"known_invalid_patterns":["Guessing or fabricating moves without evidence from the video.","Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient evidence.","Using partial transcript or partial move list as completion."],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace and tool availability.","Download or otherwise obtain the referenced video.","Extract the move sequence from the video with evidence-backed inspection.","Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence."],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/local video copy.","Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move list from the video.","Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered move list."],"notes":["If direct download is unavailable, use any visible alternate route that still yields evidence-backed access to the video content."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '\nFILES:\n'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '\nTOOLS:\n'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)" || echo "$t=missing"; done","timeout":120000,"receipt_requested":true}]}

set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '
FILES:
'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '
TOOLS:
'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)" || echo "$t=missing"; done
